raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: mapserver
  version: "8.6.6"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://download.osgeo.org/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e908e76b65541042042e9c5e4ae16a131f064cf6d3c76e9542c89b25158968c9

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - if: unix
      then:
        - make
        - pkg-config
      else: ninja
    # Unknown why, but necessary in build deps
    - protobuf-c
    # appease osx arm64
    - swig <4.5
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - cairo
    - fcgi2
    - fribidi
    - freetype
    - geos
    - giflib
    - harfbuzz
    - libcurl
    - libgdal-core
    - libiconv
    - libjpeg-turbo
    - libpng
    - libpq
    - libxml2-devel
    - mysql-devel
    - openssl
    - pcre2
    - pixman
    - pkg-config
    - postgresql
    - proj
    - protobuf-c
    - setuptools
    - swig <4.5
    - if: not win
      then: unixodbc
    - zlib
    - zstd
  run:
    - python
    - protobuf-c
    - fcgi2
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, upper_bound='x.x.x') }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - if: not osx
          then: mapscript
      pip_check: false
  - script:
      - mapserv -v

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Platform for publishing spatial data and interative mapping.
  description: |
    MapServer is an Open Source platform for publishing spatial data and
    interactive mapping applications to the web. MapServer is not a
    full-featured GIS system, nor does it aspire to be
  homepage: https://mapserver.org/
  repository: https://github.com/MapServer/MapServer
  documentation: https://mapserver.org/documentation.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - akrherz
    - hobu
    - msmitherdc
